method.check_1: Confirm source identity, publisher, title, and persistent official or DOI landing page.
method.check_2: Read the exact table, figure, section, abstract, or data field and preserve baseline, unit, range, scenario, and confidence.
method.check_3: Corroborate with an independent assessment/source or reproduce the value from the named underlying dataset.
method.important_note: Three checks do not mean three interchangeable estimates. A primary assessment may synthesize many studies; corroboration checks interpretation without averaging unlike metrics.

checks.evidence: IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report official report page and DOI resolve to the 2023 assessment.
SPM A.1 and A.1.1 use the calibrated term unequivocal and report 1.1 C for 2011-2020.
AR6 WGI SPM A.1.3 and FAQ 3.1 independently show formal detection-and-attribution evidence, including model experiments with and without human influence.
Official IPCC AR6 WGI report and figure pages verified.
Figure SPM.2 values and uncertainty ranges transcribed without netting GHG warming and aerosol cooling into a false single-gas value.
FAQ 3.1 simulation comparison independently corroborates the human fingerprint; observed warming is not reproduced by natural-only forcing.
Official IPCC WGI and Synthesis Report pages verified.
WGI SPM D.1.1 reports 0.27-0.63 C per 1,000 GtCO2, best 0.45 C.
Synthesis Report B.5.2 repeats the cumulative-emissions relationship; Global Carbon Budget data independently provide the compatible cumulative-CO2 series used by the dashboard.
NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory CO2 and NASA GISTEMP v4 official data products verified.
Annual series were joined by year with baselines preserved; 1979-2025 n=47 Pearson r=0.9515 and first-difference r=0.1891.
Independent NOAA GlobalTemp is retained as a second temperature record; hashes, input rows, and reproducible normalizer are included.
NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory AGGI official page and downloadable table verified.
2024 row reproduces 3.54 W/m2 total, AGGI 1.54, CO2 2.33 W/m2, and methane 0.57 W/m2.
Downloaded forcing and atmospheric mole-fraction tables are retained locally with SHA-256 hashes; values agree with NOAA page narrative.
Official IPCC AR6 WGI SPM page and Figure SPM.6 verified.
Frequency and intensity values transcribed separately at each warming level with the 1850-1900 baseline.
AR6 Synthesis Report SPM and WGI Chapter 11 corroborate monotonic escalation of heat extremes with warming.
Peer-reviewed Knutson et al. 2020 review, official IPCC Chapter 11, and NOAA GFDL synthesis pages verified.
The 2 C medians retain metric definitions and study ranges; total-frequency language remains decrease or unchanged.
IPCC and NOAA independently agree on heavier rainfall and higher intensity while warning against a simple increasing-count claim.

Very-high-risk ranges and medians transcribed by warming level and labeled as modeled risk rather than observed extinction.
IPBES independently establishes interacting non-climate drivers; IPBES-IPCC workshop corroborates climate-biodiversity interaction.
Nature Climate Change DOI/abstract, IPCC WGII Chapter 5, and USDA productivity report verified.
The 21 percent value is described as slower TFP growth relative to a counterfactual, not food-volume loss.
IPCC cites the result in its assessment; USDA independently documents the agricultural TFP measurement framework and data revisions.
Official IPCC WGII Chapter 4, WMO water-status report, and UNESCO WWDR pages verified.
The 3 and 4 billion exposure values retain low confidence and their warming levels.

WMO and UNESCO independently corroborate current regional water-cycle instability and the importance of demand, infrastructure, and governance, without being misused as validation of the same projection.
Official IPCC WGI, NOAA Climate.gov, and NASA/JPL dataset pages verified.
IPCC observed change, rate intervals, and attribution confidence transcribed exactly.
NOAA independently reports the observed rise and mechanisms; NASA/JPL metadata confirms the satellite global-mean sea-level observable.
Official IPCC WGI SPM projection table verified.
2100 and 2150 scenario ranges preserve the 1995-2014 baseline and likely-range label.
NOAA and NASA independently verify the physical mechanisms and observed continuation; no external source is used to replace IPCC scenario ranges.
Official IPCC WGII Technical Summary and Chapter 7 pages verified.
The greater-than-20-million value remains internal, annual-average, weather-related, and since-2008.
UNHCR independently confirms that most climate-related displacement is internal and warns against the climate-refugee label.
Official World Bank Groundswell Part II report landing page verified.
216 million, six-region subtotal values, 2050 horizon, and up-to-80-percent reduction were checked; metric is internal migration.
IPCC and UNHCR corroborate the scenario-conditioned, multi-causal, mostly internal framing and reject conversion to a refugee forecast.

IPCC states global voluntary climate-migration estimates are unavailable; UNHCR does not recognize climate refugee as a legal term.
